thread:
sophie: Quick follow-up from PM: postmortem INF-2024-07 done. We need to lock owners for the action items and decide RACI for the short-term mitigations. Can folks ack ownership by EOD?
jin: Ack. I'll take ownership of the KV-cache TTL audit and patch rollout.
omar: I can own the long-term caching strategy doc + the quantization config change rollbacks.
leah: I'll track the Jira tickets and create sub-tasks for testing/QA.
ryan: For the immediate canary rollback automation, I can be R: and A: on the rollout pipeline change (low risk).
kate: From SRE side I want to be C for the rollout and I for the strategy doc. Also propose adding a recurring check to detect TTL regressions.
engbot: Deploy job started: patch/kv-cache-audit-job (ci-4321).
jira-bot: Created tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2345 (KV cache audit), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2346 (canary rollback automation), https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2347 (caching strategy doc).
sophie: Thanks — let's map RACI in this thread to avoid PM handoff churn. My suggested RACI for INF-2345: R=jin, A=leah, C=kate, I=sophie/eng-oncall. Thoughts?
jin: fine with that. ETA for audit: 5 business days. I'll add timeboxed checkpoints to the ticket.
leah: I'll set up the ticket with components: eng-runtime, eng-sre, and QA. Also adding acceptance criteria + test plan.
omar: For INF-2347 (strategy doc) propose R=omar, A=sophie, C=kate/jin, I=platform-eng. Target: two-week draft.
ryan: INF-2346 (rollback automation) R=ryan, A=ryan, C=jin, I=leah. I'll try to have a canary toggle in staging by Friday.
kate: Add monitoring alerts to the canary plan: prefix miss-rate > 1% for 5m should escalate.
sophie: Good. Also, observed pattern: last three incidents had cache/TTR drift after a deployment with quantized model updates. Omar — can you add a recurrence analysis section in INF-2347 and tag older incidents?
omar: On it. I'll link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/issues/?jql=component%20%3D%20eng-runtime%20AND%20text%20~%20%22TTL%22 to gather precedent.
leah: I'm creating subtasks: QA test matrix, rollout checklist, comms plan. Assigning owners now.
jin: Quick note — to avoid blocking, I'll first run the audit as read-only: command I plan to run: ```python tools/cache_audit.py --since=168h --output=gs://redwood-audit/kv-audit.json```
ryan: FYI I'll implement a staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on error rate delta > 0.5%. Putting this in INF-2346 acceptance.
sophie: Decision: owners as above, deadlines: INF-2345 due 2026-03-31, INF-2346 due 2026-03-28, INF-2347 due 2026-04-14. If anyone needs scope changes ping me.
kate: I'll add the recurring detection to alerts and a weekly 'recurrence bucket' report to the ops dashboard. Can someone add me to the ticket watchers?
leah: Added Kate + eng-sre distro. Also linking the postmortem doc here: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/INF-2024-07.
engbot: Reminder: on-call rotation for next week: ryan -> jin -> kate.
sophie: Hand-off plan: Jin will coordinate with QA for patch validation, Ryan will handle rollout automation, Omar will draft strategy, Leah will track tickets and follow up in weekly remediation sync. I'll close the loop in next PM status.
jin: Acknowledged. I'll update INF-2345 with checkpoints and log the initial read-only audit by tomorrow.
ryan: Will open a PR for the canary toggle (draft) and add integration tests.
omar: Draft skeleton for strategy doc pushed to INF-2347. Please review when available.
leah: Scheduling a 30m triage swimlane on Thursday 11:00 to review acceptance criteria and handoffs; invite sent.
sophie: Thanks all — if no objections I'll mark these tickets as "actioned" in the postmortem tracker and set weekly reminders until closed. :white_check_mark:
ryan: No objections. :+1:
kate: Sounds good. Adding alert runbook notes to INF-2346.
jira-bot: INF-2345 status: In Progress. INF-2346 status: In Progress. INF-2347 status: In Progress.
sophie: Closing the thread — will post a follow-up summary after Thursday's triage.
